SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. S. REGISTRY.
No. D 7514 A
Date ____ 1 / 4 / 37

April 16, 1937. 3 . Afternoon Translation.

when the matter was referred to the Municipal Police for
investigation by the Shanghai First Special District Court.
Sung Sao-ching, as well as his wife Sung Chu-sz (孙朱氏),
were arrested and as a result of proceedings, they were found
guilty of the charge. Consequently, Sung Sao-ching was
sentenced to five years' imprisonment, in addition to a fine
of $1,000 for offences of successive extortion and was deprived
of his civil rights for a period of 10 years, while his wife
was sentenced to 1 year's imprisonment for giving false
evidence. She was acquitted on the charges of contracting
management of lawsuits of another and extortion.
As before stated, this case was initiated through
a private prosecution brought against Sung by his accomplice
Kiang Chao-chow. However, as the facts outlined in the
prosecution indicated a criminal charge, the Court, after its
receipt of this prosecution, referred the matter to the Central
Police Station for investigation. As a result of enquiries
conducted by Asst. Supt. Loh Lien-kwe and other police officers,
the following cases which were managed by Sung Sao-ching and
his accomplice Kiang Chao-chow, who is now at large, since
the winter of 1931 up to March last year, were brought to light:-
(1) Extortion of $40,000 from Wu Teng-ying (吴登瀛). Sung
only gave $12,500 to Wu's sister, Sung Wu-sz (孙吴氏),
and the rest he misappropriated. This aroused the
dissatisfaction of Sung Wu-sz who afterwards wrote a
letter to this effect to the Huchow Guild.
(2) Extortion of $70,000 from Chow Hsiang-yung (周湘云).
Sung only gave $5,000 to Wu Ngoh-hu (吴月娥), while
the rest was misappropriated by him together with Tang
Kia-pang (唐家鹏), the late Manager of the Great
World Amusement Resort on Avenue Edward VII.
(3) Extortion of $40,000 from Sze Tuh-tse (施笃之).
(4) Extortion of $67,000 from Loh Kwan-tseng (罗冠曾).
$30,000 was given to Loh Chu-shang (罗祖裳), while the
remainder was taken by Sung.
(5) Extortion of $20,000 from Hsu Mou-chong (徐懋昌).
$3,000 only was given to Pan Chao-sz (潘赵氏), the
mother of Pan Sih-yen (潘世彦).
(6) Extortion of $47,000 from Chiang Yang-sz (蒋杨氏).
According to the lengthy judgment handed down
by Judge Chien Hung-nieh (钱洪业), Chief of the Criminal
Division of the Shanghai First Special District Court,
although some of these crimes were committed by the accused
prior to the promulgation of the new Criminal Code, they
were, however, punishable for extortion following their
contraction of management of lawsuits of another according
to the old Criminal Code.
The accused were, therefore, sentenced as above
mentioned in accordance with Articles 28, 56, 346 (Section 1),
157 (Section 2), 55, 37 (Section 2), 42 (Sections 2 and 3),
2 (First Half of Section 1), and 168 of the Criminal Code
and Articles 291 (First Half) and 293 (Section 1) of the
Code of Criminal Procedure.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别科登记处。
编号 D 7514 A
日期 ____ 1937年4月1日

1937年4月16日。下午译本。

此事经上海第一特区地方法院移交工部局警务处进行调查。孙绍清及其妻子孙朱氏（Sung Chu-sz）被捕，经诉讼程序，被裁定罪名成立。因此，孙绍清因连续敲诈勒索罪被判处五年徒刑，并处罚金1,000元，同时被剥夺公民权十年；其妻子因作伪证被判处一年徒刑。她所受的包揽他人诉讼及敲诈勒索指控则被判无罪。

如前所述，本案系由孙绍清的同伙江兆周（Kiang Chao-chow）对其提起自诉而引发。然而，由于自诉书中陈述的事实表明涉及刑事犯罪，法院在收到该自诉后，将此事移交中央捕房进行调查。经副督察长骆连贵（Loh Lien-kwe，音译）及其他警官开展调查，查明了孙绍清与其目前在逃的同伙江兆周自1931年冬季至去年三月期间经手的以下案件：

(1) 向吴登瀛（Wu Teng-ying）敲诈勒索40,000元。孙绍清仅将12,500元交给吴登瀛的妹妹孙吴氏（Sung Wu-sz），其余款项被他侵吞。这引起了孙吴氏的不满，她随后就此致函湖州会馆。

(2) 向周湘云（Chow Hsiang-yung）敲诈勒索70,000元。孙绍清仅将5,000元交给吴月娥（Wu Ngoh-hu，音译），其余款项被他与已故爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）大世界游乐场经理唐家鹏（Tang Kia-pang，音译）共同侵吞。

(3) 向施笃之（Sze Tuh-tse）敲诈勒索40,000元。

(4) 向罗冠曾（Loh Kwan-tseng）敲诈勒索67,000元。其中30,000元交给了罗祖裳（Loh Chu-shang，音译），其余部分被孙绍清占有。

(5) 向徐懋昌（Hsu Mou-chong）敲诈勒索20,000元。仅将3,000元交给潘世彦（Pan Sih-yen，音译）的母亲潘赵氏（Pan Chao-sz）。

(6) 向蒋杨氏（Chiang Yang-sz）敲诈勒索47,000元。

根据上海第一特区地方法院刑庭庭长钱洪业（Chien Hung-nieh）作出的 lengthy（原文用词，意为冗长的）判决书，尽管被告人的部分犯罪行为发生在新刑法颁布之前，但根据旧刑法，其在包揽他人诉讼之后实施的敲诈勒索行为仍应受到惩罚。

因此，依据《刑法》第28条、第56条、第346条（第一款）、第157条（第二款）、第55条、第37条（第二款）、第42条（第二、三款）、第2条（第一款前半部分）和第168条，以及《刑事诉讼法》第291条（前半部分）和第293条（第一款），对被告人作出上述判决。
